name: slides-purryst
description: SlidesPurryst: Where Typst meets Vue in purr-fect harmony.

scripts.build:slides: typst compile --root . --input "slides-purryst-path=../dist/slides-purryst.es.js" --input "slides-purryst-css-path=../dist/slides-purryst.css" --input "slides-purryst-module=true" --format html --features html example/slides.typ example/index.html
scripts.build:slides:pp: pnpm build:slides && npx prettier --write --parser html example/index.html
scripts.watch:slides: typst watch --no-serve --root . --input "slides-purryst-path=../dist/slides-purryst.es.js" --input "slides-purryst-css-path=../dist/slides-purryst.css" --input "slides-purryst-module=true" --format html --features html example/slides.typ example/index.html
